input: app.use('/support/logs', serveIndexMiddleware, serveIndex('logs', { icons: true, view: 'details' })) // vuln-code-snippet vuln-line accessLogDisclosureChallenge

value.reason: The line publishes a server-side 'logs' directory over HTTP at /support/logs using serve-index with detailed listings and icons, and the snippet shows no authentication or access control. Access logs commonly contain client IPs, user agents, request paths, and sometimes user identifiers or emails, so anyone can list and read personal data. The inline 'vuln-code-snippet' markers indicate an intentionally vulnerable training app, but that does not change the finding: the code exposes a personal-data directory publicly, which matches SEC-07.
